# Press-On Nails Market

Reusable, salon-look **nail** sets that require no cure step — the fastest DIY
convenience format and a core driver of [[At-Home Nail Care Disruption]].

## Why it grows

- No LED lamp or soak-off step, unlike at-home gel.
- Reusable across wears, lowering effective cost per manicure.
- Fashion-forward designs refreshed on a seasonal cadence.

[[Olive and June]] and other DTC brands treat press-ons as an entry SKU that
pulls shoppers toward a broader nail-care line.
